notes.title: Month 1 Content Update Summary!
notes.notes:
Maps and Modes
-added 8 maps for Last-Team-Standing Mode
-added infected mode (with 4 maps)

QoLs:
-added radial menu on Q for consumables.
-overhauled menu system,
-added steam invite support

Items:
 - Trophy System (To keep you and your team safe from grenades, RPGs, etc.
 - Landmine (To keep those enemies out of your area)
 - AS-Val (Semi-Auto Medium Range Sniper with DEVASTATING knock-down capability)
 - SCAR-L ( Everyone's favorite assault rifle, pricey with a purpose)
